note: Tiny pytest-shaped catalog for the GaussIQ 1.0 demo tenant. Pages replays this JSON. Python tests under tests/gaussiq_suites/ own the live checks. product = golden-case Case Intelligence (ingest fixtures, assert expected outcomes).

cases.name: Signal connector stays Running so evidence is current

rca.symptom: Case Intelligence plans arrive empty because similar-case evidence is stale.
rca.cause: The ticketing signal connector is crash-looping. Historical cases are not landing in the evidence index.
rca.fix: Restore signal-connector before trusting AJ18991 similar-case matches. Do not treat empty evidence as a missing KB article.

cases.name: AJ18991 plan names cert SAN mismatch, not generic HTTP 500
cases.actual: HTTP 500 still open; cert SAN sandbox vs production

rca.symptom: AJ18991 — Spaceley Sprocket migration tool returns HTTP 500 in the EMEA sandbox.
rca.cause: Certificate SAN does not match the sandbox host. The 500 is the symptom, not application code.
rca.fix: Reissue the sandbox certificate with the matching SAN, then re-run the migration job. Do not patch the SFM wizard for a generic 500.

cases.name: Gross and net MTTR exist in the performance fixture
TLS / certificate skill gap is listed for this shift
Case Intelligence GraphQL requires a session

rca.symptom: Case Intelligence GraphQL answered without a session cookie.
rca.cause: Auth is not required on this demo endpoint. Anyone who can reach it can read case plans. Fixture finding, not a live exploit.
rca.fix: Require a session on case-intel-api before serving case plans. A 200 from /health is not proof that auth is on.

cases.name: Recommendation engine logs do not echo Authorization
cases.actual: Authorization Bearer redacted token in rec-engine log

rca.symptom: A token-like value appeared in rec-engine logs.
rca.cause: The recommendation engine echoed an Authorization header. Shown redacted: giq_lab_****redacted****.
rca.fix: Stop logging Authorization headers. Rotate the lab token.
